literal_meaning: চাকরি (job or service) এবং বাকরি (rhyming extension, implying similar employments)
figurative_meaning_bn: কাজকর্ম; চাকরি বা ঐ ধরণের জীবিকা; জীবিকার সংস্থান
figurative_meaning_en: Jobs and employment; work or means of livelihood
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চাকরি-বাকরি নিয়ে সবসময় চিন্তা করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is always worried about his job and employment.
Finding jobs and work in the village is difficult.
note: This is a rhyming idiom (sahachara shabda) commonly used in everyday Bengali speech to refer to occupational pursuits.
